blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Agana Bridge in Tarlac is expected to reopen to pedestrians and light vehicles on Monday or Tuesday, nearly three weeks after it partially collapsed due to strong river currents and heavy rains, Public Works and Highways Secretary Vince Dizon said Sunday.
